faqs.a: Every iPhone from the XS and XR onward supports eSIM, including all iPhone 11 to 16 models and the iPhone SE (2nd generation and later). The exception is iPhones sold in mainland China, which have no eSIM. To confirm on your own phone, dial *#06#: if an EID number appears, the eSIMFlys eSIM will install.

faqs.q: Which Samsung and Google Pixel phones support eSIM?
faqs.a: Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer, the Z Fold and Z Flip series and Note 20 support eSIM on most regional variants. Google Pixel 3 and newer support it, though the Pixel 3 and 3a only on some carriers. Because support varies by region and carrier lock, check Settings for an "Add eSIM" option or dial *#06# for an EID before you buy.

faqs.q: How do I check if my phone is eSIM-capable and unlocked?
faqs.a: Dial *#06# and look for a line labelled EID; if it is there the hardware supports eSIM. Then confirm the phone is carrier-unlocked, because a locked phone rejects any profile that is not from its home carrier. On iPhone, Settings → General → About shows "No SIM restrictions" when it is unlocked.
